dedupe_keys.name: baltic region energy system data set ines database

description: The Baltic region data set is an energy system model input database for Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, prepared in the INES (Interoperable Energy System) format with a validated Spine Toolbox workflow. The electricity system is represented at country level with interconnections to neighbouring systems, using cross-border exchange data from a pan-European model, while the heating system has finer spatial detail: capital-city areas and other regional zones are distinguished, Latvia's capital heating network is split into two subsystems, and an additional NUTS-3 region is separated to reflect local constraints. It was prepared by Diana Zalostiba, Karlis Baltputnis, Anna Mutule, Zane Broka and Jana Teremranova to support energy system modelling of the Baltic states. It is a single SQLite file of about 33 MB on Zenodo, published in February 2026 under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the authors warn that the data set is under development and will be updated until December 2026, so contents may change between versions, and the provider's affiliation is not stated on the record. Simulation uses are capacity planning and optimisation of coupled electricity and district heating systems. Related records: the INES format is built for Spine Toolbox workflows and SpineOpt, catalogued as model-spineopt.
